::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/womenShots.csv"
shots=read.csv(url)
```
:::


Logistic model with one variable


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
shots$Goal_1=ifelse(shots$Goal=="Goal",1,0)
fit_glm=glm(Goal_1~yj,data=shots)
summary(fit_glm)
```

Model Predictions


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
new_df=data.frame(yj=1:10)
preds=predict(fit_glm,new_df,type="response")
plot(preds)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}

:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
yhat=ifelse(preds>0.5,"Goal","Not Goal")
yhat
```

Calculating overall accuracy


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
preds=predict(fit_glm,type="response")
yhat=ifelse(preds>0.5,"Goal","Not Goal")

sum(yhat==shots$Goal)/nrow(shots) #Accuracy
```
